hip_history_policy.prior_one_set: retain one supporting set at compatible actual range/dose
hip_history_policy.prior_two_sets: deliberately reduce to one supporting set for stopping/unilateral priority

P1.variant: Split-Squat Isometric Hold — supported-bodyweight-mid-range plus supported bilateral finish — explicit orientation composite
P1.effort_load: Bodyweight, easy2/10. Each lead holds3s. Use light wall contact with the hand on the front-leg side; free hand at hip. No pushing to an end range.
P1.notes: One composite cycle:5s entry/setup,3s left-lead hold,5s standing side change,3s right-lead hold,2s return to bilateral base,2s supported soft-knee finish,5s exit to the adjacent queue. These25s include both sides and the bilateral finish; do not repeat the cycle for each side.

P2.variant: Walk-to-Stick — explicitly authored prerequisite lesson
P2.effort_load: Bodyweight, ordinary deliberate walking, about2/10 effort; gradual short braking steps, no jog or abrupt plant.
P2.notes: One approach/stop attempt per set, including invalid attempts. The10s envelope covers approach, gradual braking,2s bilateral hold and exit from the active lane; it is not a forced movement tempo. Separate outside walking return allowance is15s. P2 exits by its designated side gate only after the completed hold; E1 walks straight through the protected clearance. No athletic cut, reacceleration or replacement attempt.

E1.variant: Submaximal Linear Deceleration to Stick — submaximal-linear-multistep-deceleration-to-bilateral-stick
E1.effort_load: Bodyweight, gentle easy jog, about3/10 effort. Use a clearly submaximal approach; source50–65% is contextual, not a measured prescription or reason to test maximum speed. Natural relaxed arm action.
E1.notes: One approach/stop attempt per set, including invalid attempts. The15s envelope covers approach, gradual braking,2s bilateral hold and exit from the active lane; it is not a forced movement tempo. Separate outside walking return allowance is25s. P2 exits by its designated side gate only after the completed hold; E1 walks straight through the protected clearance. No athletic cut, reacceleration or replacement attempt.

S1.variant: Split-Squat Isometric Hold — supported-bodyweight-mid-range
S1.effort_load: Bodyweight, easy2–3/10; one5s hold per lead with normal breathing, well before shaking/strain. Light wall contact, same declared comfortable depth; no external load.
S1.notes: One combined both-side set, not two sets. Two counted holds×5s +10s stand/change lead/support hand +15s total initial setup/controlled entry and final exit = 35s. The hold clock begins only in the assigned position; entry and exit are counted actions, not extra dynamic split-squat repetitions.

S2.variant: Bodyweight Hip Hinge Good Morning — arms crossed at chest
S2.effort_load: Bodyweight;3s hips back/1s stand, at least5 good reps in reserve. Retain the actual comfortable range and arm position.

S3.variant: Incline Push-Up — individually verified stable high support
S3.effort_load: Bodyweight;2s lower/1s press, at least5 good reps in reserve.90cm is a planning reference only; retain the qualified actual support height and foot position or select a suitable high surface for instruction.
S3.notes: Record actual support height. Older age does not lower the surface or add repetitions.

S4.variant: One-Arm Row — opposite hand AND knee on bench
S4.effort_load: One manageable dumbbell: retain a qualified light prior load, or select a very light load for first instruction; at least5 good reps in reserve.1s pull/1s top/2s lower. Record actual kg.
S4.notes: One set includes both sides.10s side change plus10s total pickup/set-down; first listed rep is the observation, never an extra test rep.

S5.variant: Dead Bug Heel Tap — fixed vertical arms, alternating bent-leg heel contact and return
S5.effort_load: Bodyweight, low-load control;2s lower/2s return, natural breathing. Retain a comfortable declared heel target/range without trunk movement.
S5.notes: Tabletop is checked during setup; the first listed heel contact is the counted moving-limb observation. Strength placement is an explicit adaptation of the local preparation profile.

hip_history_policy.prior_one_set: retain one supporting set at compatible actual range/dose

P1.variant: Supported High Split-Stance Hold — instructional adaptation plus supported bilateral finish — explicit orientation composite
P1.effort_load: Bodyweight, easy2/10. Each lead holds3s. Use light wall contact with the hand on the front-leg side; free hand at hip. No pushing to an end range.
P1.notes: One composite cycle:5s entry/setup,3s left-lead hold,5s standing side change,3s right-lead hold,2s return to bilateral base,2s supported soft-knee finish,5s exit to the adjacent queue. These25s include both sides and the bilateral finish; do not repeat the cycle for each side.

P2.variant: Walk-to-Stick — explicitly authored prerequisite lesson
P2.effort_load: Bodyweight, ordinary deliberate walking, about2/10 effort; gradual short braking steps, no jog or abrupt plant.
P2.notes: One approach/stop attempt per set, including invalid attempts. The10s envelope covers approach, gradual braking,2s bilateral hold and exit from the active lane; it is not a forced movement tempo. Separate outside walking return allowance is15s. P2 exits by its designated side gate only after the completed hold; E1 walks straight through the protected clearance. No athletic cut, reacceleration or replacement attempt.

E1.variant: Submaximal Linear Deceleration to Stick — submaximal-linear-multistep-deceleration-to-bilateral-stick
E1.effort_load: Bodyweight, gentle easy jog, about3/10 effort. Use a clearly submaximal approach; source50–65% is contextual, not a measured prescription or reason to test maximum speed. Natural relaxed arm action.
E1.notes: One approach/stop attempt per set, including invalid attempts. The15s envelope covers approach, gradual braking,2s bilateral hold and exit from the active lane; it is not a forced movement tempo. Separate outside walking return allowance is25s. P2 exits by its designated side gate only after the completed hold; E1 walks straight through the protected clearance. No athletic cut, reacceleration or replacement attempt.

S1.variant: Supported High Split-Stance Hold — instructional adaptation
S1.effort_load: Bodyweight, easy2–3/10; one5s hold per lead with normal breathing, well before shaking/strain. Light wall contact, same declared comfortable depth; no external load.
S1.notes: One combined both-side set, not two sets. Two counted holds×5s +10s stand/change lead/support hand +15s total initial setup/controlled entry and final exit = 35s. The hold clock begins only in the assigned position; entry and exit are counted actions, not extra dynamic split-squat repetitions.

S2.variant: Bodyweight Hip Hinge Good Morning — arms crossed at chest
S2.effort_load: Bodyweight;3s hips back/1s stand, at least5 good reps in reserve. Retain the actual comfortable range and arm position.

S3.variant: Incline Push-Up — individually verified stable high support
S3.effort_load: Bodyweight;2s lower/1s press, at least5 good reps in reserve.90cm is a planning reference only; retain the qualified actual support height and foot position or select a suitable high surface for instruction.
S3.notes: Record actual support height. Older age does not lower the surface or add repetitions.

S4.variant: Ring/TRX Row — verified anchors, about70-degree body angle to floor
S4.effort_load: Bodyweight;2s lower/1s pull, at least5 good reps in reserve; record actual angle.

S5.variant: Dead Bug Heel Tap — fixed vertical arms, alternating bent-leg heel contact and return
S5.effort_load: Bodyweight, low-load control;2s lower/2s return, natural breathing. Retain a comfortable declared heel target/range without trunk movement.
S5.notes: Tabletop is checked during setup; the first listed heel contact is the counted moving-limb observation. Strength placement is an explicit adaptation of the local preparation profile.

hip_history_policy.prior_one_set: retain one supporting set at compatible actual range/dose
hip_history_policy.prior_two_sets: deliberately reduce to one supporting set for stopping/unilateral priority

P1.variant: Split-Squat Isometric Hold — supported-bodyweight-mid-range plus supported bilateral finish — explicit orientation composite
P1.effort_load: Bodyweight, easy2/10. Each lead holds3s. Use light wall contact with the hand on the front-leg side; free hand at hip. No pushing to an end range.
P1.notes: One composite cycle:5s entry/setup,3s left-lead hold,5s standing side change,3s right-lead hold,2s return to bilateral base,2s supported soft-knee finish,5s exit to the adjacent queue. These25s include both sides and the bilateral finish; do not repeat the cycle for each side.

P2.variant: Slow Grounded Bilateral Finish — partial squat teaching adaptation
P2.effort_load: Bodyweight, easy2/10 and at least5 good reps in reserve. Comfortable partial bilateral squat:3s lower,2s hold,1s stand,4s reset. Arms comfortably forward; feet grounded.
P2.notes: No travel, takeoff or rapid snap-down. This observes a bilateral position only; it cannot pass a walking or jogging stop.

E1.variant: Slow Grounded Bilateral Finish — partial squat teaching adaptation
E1.effort_load: Bodyweight, easy2/10 and at least5 good reps in reserve. Comfortable partial bilateral squat:3s lower,2s hold,1s stand,4s reset. Arms comfortably forward; feet grounded.
E1.notes: No travel, takeoff or rapid snap-down. This observes a bilateral position only; it cannot pass a walking or jogging stop.

S1.variant: Split-Squat Isometric Hold — supported-bodyweight-mid-range
S1.effort_load: Bodyweight, easy2–3/10; one3s hold per lead with normal breathing, well before shaking/strain. Light wall contact, same declared comfortable depth; no external load.
S1.notes: One combined both-side set, not two sets. Two counted holds×3s +10s stand/change lead/support hand +15s total initial setup/controlled entry and final exit = 31s. The hold clock begins only in the assigned position; entry and exit are counted actions, not extra dynamic split-squat repetitions.

S2.variant: Bodyweight Hip Hinge Good Morning — arms crossed at chest
S2.effort_load: Bodyweight;3s hips back/1s stand, at least5 good reps in reserve. Retain the actual comfortable range and arm position.

S3.variant: Incline Push-Up — individually verified stable high support
S3.effort_load: Bodyweight;2s lower/1s press, at least5 good reps in reserve.90cm is a planning reference only; retain the qualified actual support height and foot position or select a suitable high surface for instruction.
S3.notes: Record actual support height. Older age does not lower the surface or add repetitions.

S4.variant: Ring/TRX Row — verified anchors, about70-degree body angle to floor
S4.effort_load: Bodyweight;2s lower/1s pull, at least5 good reps in reserve; record actual angle.

S5.variant: Dead Bug Heel Tap — fixed vertical arms, alternating bent-leg heel contact and return
S5.effort_load: Bodyweight, low-load control;2s lower/2s return, natural breathing. Retain a comfortable declared heel target/range without trunk movement.
S5.notes: Tabletop is checked during setup; the first listed heel contact is the counted moving-limb observation. Strength placement is an explicit adaptation of the local preparation profile.
